content.user_title: Generate Better Images From Any Creative Brief
content.value_statement: Image requests often fail because prompts and model choices do not match the intended result. This skill routes each brief and builds a model-specific prompt.
actual_capabilities: Routes image briefs by text accuracy, visual style, photographic realism, editing needs, and identity preservation.
Builds prompts using model-specific structures for GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, and Grok.
Applies dedicated recipes for posters, portraits, social graphics, and cinematic stills.
Analyzes supplied references and states which visual details must remain fixed.
Generates multiple requests together and reconnects to pending jobs without duplicate generation.
Returns completed image URLs and local file paths.
limitations: Commercial product photography belongs to a separate product-photo skill.
Generated text, faces, hands, layouts, and cross-image identity can still vary.
Transparent backgrounds are unavailable in the documented models.
Image generation requires a configured provider and may return an asynchronous pending job.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Graphics
use_cases.description: Build posters, banners, thumbnails, and social graphics with controlled copy, hierarchy, palette, and layout.

use_cases.title: Develop Consistent Portraits
use_cases.description: Generate or edit portraits while preserving facial features, wardrobe, lighting, and visual style across a set.

use_cases.title: Produce Cinematic Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn scene briefs into cinematic stills with explicit framing, lenses, lighting, materials, grading, and factual constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [style], [lighting], and a [aspect ratio] frame.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a direct text-to-image request without references.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Copy-Bearing Graphic
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [format] for [audience]. Show [subject]. Render "[exact text]" in [type style] at [placement]. Use [colors] and preserve [constraints].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for posters, banners, thumbnails, advertisements, or infographics.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit Image 1 by changing [target] to [new state]. Preserve [identity, geometry, palette, or text]. Match [reference role] from Image 2.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when supplied images define the subject, style, background, or element to transfer.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Consistent Image Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [count] images of [fully repeated subject description]. Keep [wardrobe, palette, lighting, and style] identical. Vary only [shot, action, framing, or ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced multi-image campaigns or character sets.

output_examples.input: Create a square launch poster with the headline NIGHT RUN and a runner beneath neon city lights.
output_examples.output: A square poster with exact headline placement, high-contrast typography, a centered runner, neon lighting, restrained copy, and fixed layout constraints.

output_examples.input: Edit my portrait into a cinematic rainy street while keeping my face and jacket recognizable.
output_examples.output: A reference-guided portrait edit preserving facial identity and clothing, with wet pavement, controlled lens depth, directional rain, and a cool cinematic grade.

output_examples.input: Generate three matching editorial images of one chef in different kitchen scenes.
output_examples.output: Three coordinated images with repeated subject and wardrobe details, consistent lighting and palette, and distinct framing for each kitchen scene.

best_practices: Provide exact on-image text, required dimensions, and any details that must remain unchanged.
Label each reference image by role, such as subject, style, background, or preserved asset.
Repeat subject, wardrobe, lighting, and palette descriptions in every request for a consistent set.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on vague quality words when concrete materials, lighting, framing, and style are available.
Do not resubmit a pending generation because that can create a second billed job.
Do not assume generated sets share identity when each request lacks the complete repeated description.

faq.question: Can this skill edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use supplied images to replace elements, change settings, transfer styles, and preserve specified details.

faq.question: Which image models does it support?
faq.answer: It provides routing and prompt guidance for GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, and Grok image models.

faq.question: Can it create several images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. It can batch different requests and repeat stable descriptions across a coordinated set.

faq.question: Does it support text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes copy-heavy work toward a suitable model and specifies exact wording, placement, size, color, and hierarchy.

faq.question: Can it preserve a person's identity?
faq.answer: It can use references and preservation constraints, but users should verify each result because identity consistency is imperfect.

faq.question: What happens when generation remains pending?
faq.answer: The skill reconnects with the existing job handle and waits for completion instead of starting another billed generation.
